$comment: Validates _source/published-entries.json, which is the single source of truth for table T-064 of Chapter 5.3 (CR-581).

The schema sees the SHAPE. What JSON Schema cannot say -- a row id or a component written twice, a name published twice by one row, a note that would stop check 26b reading its name -- is refused by published_entries_json_to_md.py.
title: The published-entries manuscript
description: Table T-064: per component, the names its public entry publishes, in print order.

prose.description: Printed prose, one string per language (check 23).

sepAfter.description: The joint printed between this piece and the next. Omitted means the full-width slash followed by one space; spaced adds a space before it, bare prints the slash alone.

member.description: A name the component's public entry exports. The note is printed right after the back-quoted name.

text.description: A piece of the member cell that publishes no name. Check 26b skips it and counts the skip.

$comment.description: Notes for whoever edits this manuscript. JSON carries no comments, so the role declaration goes here -- one line per note, the same shape settings.json uses. Check 21 reads the first of them. Not rendered.

columns.description: The column headings, one list per language.
